title: Querer
explanation:
Querer says what you want. The present forms are quiero, quieres, quiere, queremos, queréis, and quieren. Quiero plus a noun is a thing. Quiero plus an infinitive is an action.

Me gustaría is the polite chunk for I would like. Memorise it as a phrase. In Spain, juice is zumo. Jugo is widely understood and is listed where this lesson accepts it.
commonMistake: Saying quiero a un café, or using quiero plus a conjugated verb. The second verb stays in the infinitive: quiero comer.
